result.subject: Request for a 30-Minute Lab Tour During Our Visit to Shanghai
result.body:
Your recent work on exoskeleton control and gait analysis at Shanghai Jiao Tong University has significantly influenced our understanding of biomechanical systems. We are a small group of engineering students visiting Shanghai to explore cutting-edge research in robotics and human movement. We are writing to seek your guidance on how to approach such complex systems.

We are particularly interested in your research on gait analysis and its application in exoskeleton control. Our group hopes to learn more about how these technologies can enhance mobility and rehabilitation. Your insights would greatly enrich our understanding of the practical implications of your work.

We would be honored to request a 30-minute lab tour during our visit. We are happy to adapt to your schedule and are flexible regarding the timing. Thank you for considering our request.
